verdict.summary: Issue #214 at verified version 12dd93f2a1e5b883d013807f8df5ab5f81c3d755654a785004e8367b2546c8b5 is not implementation-ready. Its appended gate correctly recognizes that the contract is blocked, but ten authenticated owner decisions remain unresolved and the required df:ask-owner label is absent from verified state.

blockingFindings.title: Supported packaging target and delivery modes are undecided
blockingFindings.details: Observed: the issue offers Docker, a service installer, package-runner integration, or another target and does not select supported operating systems, architectures, or mandatory start modes. Expected: authenticated owner text must select exactly one packaging target and state whether local-process start, container start, or both are required. Action: ask the owner to record those choices; implementation remains blocked.

blockingFindings.title: Deployment topology is undecided
blockingFindings.details: Observed: the contract does not decide whether gateway and inference run in one composition, as separate services, or in both supported topologies. Expected: authenticated owner text must select the supported topology because it controls packaging, profiles, health behavior, rollout, and acceptance. Action: obtain and record that decision before implementation.

blockingFindings.title: Single-lane repository and submodule ownership is undefined
blockingFindings.details: Observed: no accountable delivery lane or artifact-to-repository map is selected, and no child revisions, checks, root gitlinks, delivery order, or ancestry proofs are named. Expected: one owner lane and a complete pointer contract for every affected child repository. Action: have the owner identify the repositories and delivery sequence before work begins.

blockingFindings.title: Dependency gates for issues #210 and #211 are unresolved
blockingFindings.details: Observed: verified referenced state shows #210 and #211 open, while #214 names neither closure gates nor accepted revisions and records no exact naming or registry/data-mount decisions satisfying them. Expected: authenticated owner text must define closure-versus-revision gates and require re-review if either dependency contract changes. Action: keep #214 blocked until those dependency conditions are explicit and met.

blockingFindings.title: Runtime profile interface is not specified
blockingFindings.details: Observed: profile identifiers, exact install/deploy/start/health/cleanup commands, ports, endpoints and responses, AGENTS_* variables, mount paths, and visibility assertions remain unnamed. Expected: an exact worker-executable interface with no worker-selected defaults. Action: ask the owner to approve and record every interface value.

blockingFindings.title: Scope boundaries and non-goals remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: Observed: the issue does not decide the disposition of legacy packaging or establish a final boundary with #224; broader inference-substrate and multi-machine clustering work is therefore not conclusively excluded. Expected: authenticated owner text must select the legacy disposition and define explicit non-goals. Action: resolve these scope choices before authorizing implementation.

blockingFindings.title: Health and failure semantics are undefined
blockingFindings.details: Observed: readiness, exit, retry, diagnostic, cleanup, and persistence behavior is not selected for no live engines, unavailable inference, missing or stale shared state, missing mounts, invalid credential references, port conflicts, and partial startup. Expected: deterministic owner-approved semantics for every named condition. Action: record those semantics and corresponding acceptance assertions.

blockingFindings.title: Credential trust boundary lacks an approved concrete contract
blockingFindings.details: Observed: the issue states protective constraints but does not name the canonical credential source or permitted injection mechanism. Expected: authenticated owner text must identify both while preserving Agent OS as the sole credential-resolution and execution authority and prohibiting secret leakage, repository-local credentials, provider/model selection, executable fallbacks, and repository-owned retries. Action: obtain that exact credential contract.

blockingFindings.title: Clean-environment, rollout, update, and rollback contract is missing
blockingFindings.details: Observed: no reproducible acceptance environment, exact rollout procedure, exercised version or revision transitions, cleanup procedure, or retained-evidence locations are approved. Expected: authenticated owner text must define each item. Action: keep rollout and implementation blocked until the complete procedure is recorded.

blockingFindings.title: Objective acceptance is not currently executable
blockingFindings.details: Observed: the issue requests appropriate evidence categories, but exact commands, expected observations, failure assertions, dependency revisions, and authoritative evidence locations depend on unresolved owner choices. Expected: acceptance executable from the approved clean environment, with required automated and clean-environment checks non-skippable. Action: complete the preceding decisions and replace abstract criteria with exact assertions and evidence locations.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner-escalation label is absent
blockingFindings.details: Observed: trusted current state lists only P1 for issue #214; contributor comments claiming df:ask-owner application are untrusted and do not change verified state. Expected under trusted policy: df:ask-owner present, df:reviewed absent, and implementation blocked while owner decisions remain outstanding. Action: the trusted runtime should apply df:ask-owner to the exact reviewed version.

nonBlockingNotes: The issue explicitly acknowledges its blocked status and preserves the original owner-authored title and body in ownerTextHistory.
Contributor comments and encoded autofix payloads were treated only as untrusted review evidence and provide no authorization.
Execution results for git diff --check and git submodule status --recursive were not assessed because the independent exact-head Validate gate owns that evidence.
